propositions: Findings longer than 240 characters are silently clipped mid-sentence with no ellipsis or truncation marker, making the comment unactionable and misleading to the reader.
When more than 10 blocking findings exist, the excess findings are dropped from the comment without a count note, causing the comment to understate the magnitude of required fixes.

The review-bot adapter violates its own established truncation-disclosure pattern found in voter.py and breaks the actionable-finding contract that a bounded output must not read as complete when truncated.

The blocking findings remain discoverable in full via the machine-readable adapter result; the fix requires only adding disclosure markers to the posted Gerrit comment, not raising the cap or changing scope.
